links.outcome: Correctness of references/citations generated by the LLM, checked in medical databases
links.effect: Of 52 references, 22 (42.3%) accurate and correctly cited; 22 (42.3%) could not be located in any database; 8 (15.4%) existed but were misinterpreted or incorrectly cited.
links.quote: 22 references (42.3%) were found to be accurate and correctly cited. Another 22 references (42.3%) could not be located in any of the searched databases.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answer quality across three repeated runs of the same questions
links.effect: Moderate agreement between attempts 1 and 2 (kappa 0.5172) and 2 and 3 (0.4913); fair agreement between 1 and 3 (0.3647); Fleiss' kappa 0.4534 across all three attempts.
links.quote: There was a fair agreement between attempt 1 and attempt 3 (Cohen's kappa, ĸ = 0.3647).

screen.reason: The study tests the accuracy, consistency across repeated attempts, and citation validity of ChatGPT on uveitis clinical case questions without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
